planets.name: WASP-131 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-131 with a 5.32-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-131 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-131. Its orbit and size follow Doyle et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DOYLE_ET_AL__2023): disc_year 2016, disc_facility SuperWASP-South, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 5.3220125, pl_radj 1.226, pl_bmassj 0.273

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
